  int u, v;
  long long cap, flow;
  Edge() {}
  Edge(int u, int v, long long cap): u(u), v(v), cap(cap), flow(0) {}

  int nodeCount;
  vector<Edge> edges;
  vector<vector<int>> graph;
  vector<int> dist, ptr;

  MaxFlowSolver(int N): nodeCount(N), edges(0), graph(N), dist(N), ptr(N) {}

  void addEdge(int u, int v, long long cap) {
    if (u != v) {
      edges.emplace_back(Edge(u, v, cap));
      graph[u].push_back(edges.size() - 1);
      edges.emplace_back(Edge(v, u, 0));
      graph[v].push_back(edges.size() - 1);
    }
  }

  bool buildLevelGraph(int S, int T) {
    queue<int> q({S});
    fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), nodeCount + 1);
    dist[S] = 0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
      int u = q.front(); q.pop();
      if (u == T) break;
      for (int k: graph[u]) {
        Edge &e = edges[k];
        if (e.flow < e.cap && dist[e.v] > dist[e.u] + 1) {
          dist[e.v] = dist[e.u] + 1;
          q.emplace(e.v);
        }
      }
    }
    return dist[T] != nodeCount + 1;
  }

  long long sendFlow(int u, int T, long long flow = -1) {
    if (u == T || flow == 0) return flow;
    for (int &i = ptr[u]; i < (int)graph[u].size(); ++i) {
      Edge &e = edges[graph[u][i]];
      Edge &oe = edges[graph[u][i]^1];
      if (dist[e.v] == dist[e.u] + 1) {
        long long amt = e.cap - e.flow;
        if (flow != -1 && amt > flow) amt = flow;
        long long pushed = sendFlow(e.v, T, amt);
        if (pushed > 0) {
          e.flow += pushed;
          oe.flow -= pushed;
          return pushed;
        }
      }
    }
    return 0;
  }

  long long computeMaxFlow(int S, int T) {
    long long totalFlow = 0;
    while (buildLevelGraph(S, T)) {
      fill(ptr.begin(), ptr.end(), 0);
      while (long long flow = sendFlow(S, T))
        totalFlow += flow;
    }
    return totalFlow;
  }
};
